title: DataProvenance
description: Schema for recording data provenance, source authority tier, retrieval methodology, and AI agent parametric self-description context.

provenance_id.description: Unique identifier for the provenance record (e.g., PROV-2026-08-16-001).

fact_or_metric.description: Description of the specific data point, claim, valuation metric, or financial figure.

value.description: The recorded data value (numeric, string, boolean, or structured object).

source_tier.description: Authoritative tier of the data source.

source_name.description: Name of the source (e.g., SEC EDGAR 10-K, Yahoo Finance, FRED, Internal Agent Memory).

access_method.description: Methodology used to retrieve or infer the data.

retrieval_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the data was retrieved or generated.

source_locator.description: Direct URI, accession number, search query, or local file path where source data resides.

as_of_date.description: The date for which the data is valid or reported (e.g., fiscal quarter end date or market close date).

confidence_level.description: Assessed reliability and freshness of the data point.

agent_context_signature.description: Metadata recording runtime agent state when data is produced via parametric knowledge or unverified generation.

is_parametric_knowledge.description: True if the data originates from model internal weights without external tool verification.

system_clock_timestamp.description: Current system clock timestamp observed by the agent.

active_role.description: Active agent role during deliberation (e.g., Fundamental Analyst, Valuation Specialist).

prompt_context_summary.description: Summary of active prompt and context information available to the agent at time of generation.

model_identity_state.description: Model name and training cutoff if known, or explicit statement that model metadata is unknown.

verification_status.description: Current verification state in repository audit lifecycle.
